en.H: first version in 1215. Even 800 years after its original issuance, the Magna Carta continues to be relevant today as a symbol and foundation for democracy and liberty, an influence of the United States constitution, and a lasting presence in the United Kingdom. (page break) WORKS CITED

en.A: A box appears on the screen.

en.H: Are you sure you want to turn in 📄︎ Joseph Runner – Magna Carta? (buttons) Submit / Cancel

fr.H: Êtes‐vous sûr vous vouloir rendre 📄︎ Joseph Runner – Magna Carta ? (boutons) Rendre / Annuler

en.A: The cursor selects the Submit button.

fr.t: Le curseur sélectionne le bouton Rendre.

en.A: JoeRunner leans back in his chair. He speaks in all capitals.

fr.t: JoeRunner se penche en arrière dans sa chaise. Il parle dans toutes les capitales.

en.H: (relaxed) Ahh . . . (closing eyes) Well, I’ve had enough of the Magna Carta for a lifetime.

fr.H: (relaxé) Ahh… (ferme les yeux) Eh bien, j’en ai assez de la Magna Carta pour toute une vie.

en.H: May 27. I have spent every waking moment for the last four weeks only experiencing the Magna Carta. My soul is the Magna Carta. My mind is the Magna Carta. My dreams are the Magna Carta. This school project has dragged on so long I’ve forgotten what it was like . . . before. But now it is done. With the click of a mouse, I have finally found inner peace.

en.t: I was going to not have isometric again, but the perspective tools were being weird, so congrats, you’re getting isometric again.

fr.t: Je n’allais avoir encore des dessins isométriques, mais les outils de perspective ont être nul, alors félicitations, vous avez encore des dessins isométriques.

en.t: Also, just be aware that this has no plot relevance whatsoever. This is because I have no idea what I’m doing.

fr.t: Aussi, sachez seulement que cela n’a aucune pertinence pour l’intrigue. C’est parce que je n’ai aucune idée de ce que je fais.
